topic: Design the simplest possible way for a person to configure their own local LLM (for example an LM Studio or Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint) for the communication projection, so that after a minimal one-time setup the projection AUTOMATICALLY activates and uses that model as expected, with no further manual steps. Ground every design option in the real shipped gaps: the OpenCode plugin hands projectMessage an empty provider config (so it is a guaranteed no-op today), the default judge is reject-only (so good rewrites are rejected to the exact original), and no shipped entry point (the plugin or bin/cli-output-wrapper.mjs) is pre-wired with a provider, yet a concrete HTTP transport (src/transports/http.ts) plus OpenAI-compatible and Ollama adapters already exist -- so the gap is config-and-glue, not the network layer. Cover: config discovery format, automatic provider-record construction, a judge default that permits local accepts, local-only privacy defaults, and how the plugin and wrappers auto-pick-up the configured provider. Deliver a ranked design recommendation.
